column1: # target|class|reason   (class: LINUX = preflight job, ubuntu; MACOS = cut job, before any build; BUILD_ONLY = needs build output or the signing identity)
# Order matters inside a class: scripts/run_ship_prereqs.sh runs rows top to bottom. check-orphans then check-pr-age MUST be the last two LINUX rows.
guard-local-cut|LINUX|CI guard, reads env only
check-provenance|LINUX|named fixes present in this tree and the pinned daemon tag; needs the ostler-assistant clone, no build output
check-freshness|LINUX|every shippable input against live upstream HEAD; network and tokens only
check-orphans|LINUX|is any written fix missing from this cut; gh + clones only
check-pr-age|LINUX|open PRs older than 48h; gh only (burnt v1.0.86 and v1.0.127)
check-ship-version|MACOS|reads the Info.plist stamp with macOS tooling (CANNOT-RUN on ubuntu, measured run 42411231507); needs no built .app
check-tools|MACOS|xcodebuild and xcrun are macOS-only
check-version|MACOS|runs xcodegen/xcodebuild over the tracked version sources
check-pbxproj-sync|MACOS|tracked pbxproj must equal xcodegen(project.yml); xcodegen is macOS here
check-create-dmg|MACOS|create-dmg on PATH (brew, macOS)
check-clean-tree|MACOS|cut checkout clean and on the expected branch; uses macOS tooling
check-identity|BUILD_ONLY|needs the Developer ID in a keychain; the cut job imports it just before the build
check-provenance-content|BUILD_ONLY|greps INSIDE the fetched daemon/hub/wiki artefacts, which exist only after the download-* targets
download-hub-app|BUILD_ONLY|fetches the Hub bundle into the build dir; its output is the input to the build
check-ostler-app|BUILD_ONLY|inspects the fetched Hub bundle, so needs download-hub-app output
download-safari-extension|BUILD_ONLY|fetches the extension zip into the build dir
download-python|BUILD_ONLY|fetches the Python bundle into the build dir
stage-daemon|BUILD_ONLY|fetches + unpacks the daemon into the payload
stage-payload|BUILD_ONLY|assembles the payload from the staged pieces
sparkle-embed|BUILD_ONLY|codesigns the embedded Sparkle
notarise-hub|BUILD_ONLY|signs and notarises the Hub
build-uninstaller|BUILD_ONLY|builds and signs Uninstaller.app
build-recovery|BUILD_ONLY|builds and signs Recover Ostler.app
release|BUILD_ONLY|builds and signs OstlerInstaller.app
seed-installer-app-pyc|BUILD_ONLY|needs the built .app
sign-python-bundle|BUILD_ONLY|codesigns nested Mach-O files
check-manifest|BUILD_ONLY|reads the BUILT .app
notarise-app|BUILD_ONLY|notarises the built app
staple-apps|BUILD_ONLY|staples the built apps
package|BUILD_ONLY|writes and signs the DMG
notarise-dmg|BUILD_ONLY|notarises the DMG
verify-dmg-contents|BUILD_ONLY|mounts the DMG
verify-stapling|BUILD_ONLY|mounts the DMG
verify-commit-parity|BUILD_ONLY|mounts the DMG
archive|BUILD_ONLY|copies the shipped DMG to the archive dir
